result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues: restaurant names truncated in the horizontal carousel, and category filter chips cut off at the right edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width accommodates typical restaurant name lengths without clipping.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right with a partial chip visible, and no clear affordance that more categories exist beyond 'Healthy'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate peek of the next chip and/or add a fade/scroll indicator so users know the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: Search field placeholder text appears to have a typo or awkward wording: 'Restarants, dishes, grocery' (missing 'u' in Restaurants).
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, grocery' or similar proper spelling.
